BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3622.name: Daioh-Hydra
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3622.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each "Fusion Beast"/"Ocean Emperor" family Spirit you control, destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2]
While you have a Burst set, treat the "BP+ when braved" of all opposing Brave Spirits as 0.

P15-05.name: The CleverMachineBeast Kuropard
P15-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, all "Machine Beast" family Spirits you control gain +3000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by your "Machine Beast" family Spirits via BP comparison, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
